desktop.title: Desktop
desktop.notifications: Notify me when a chat task ends
desktop.restartHint: The new directory takes effect after restart. Existing data stays in its original folder.

language.title: Language
language.botHelp: Used by every session that hasn't set its own language with /lang: for /help, error messages, notifications and the bot's replies, even when the user writes in another language. A persona that asks for a specific reply language still wins.
language.uiHelp: Only changes this admin interface in this browser, not the bot.
language.overridesHelp: These sessions use their own language instead of the default above, even if the persona asks for another one.
language.overridesEmpty: No session has set its own language with /lang yet.
language.loadFailed: Couldn't load the session language settings.

tokens.admin: Admin token: signs in to this WebUI. It's stored in data/web.token, and you can also see it with shiritaibot token. When you're signed out, the home page is the sign-in page (you can also go to /login).
tokens.adapter: Adapter access token: the password the bot uses to connect to the OneBot protocol client, entered on the Connections page. It must match the access token set in NapCat. Leave it empty if you didn't set one.
tokens.napcat: NapCat WebUI token: only for opening NapCat's own admin page (http://127.0.0.1:6099 by default). It has nothing to do with the two above.
tokens.title: About tokens

persona.collectionHint: Add several personas and switch between them with slash commands.
persona.defaultHint: Use /personas to see names and IDs, /persona <ID> to switch persona for the current session, and /persona default to go back. Only the owner can switch, and it takes effect from the next turn.

context.compress: Compress old turns into a summary
context.discard: Drop old turns when over the limit
